name: kg_grounded_qa
gold_source: runtime KG source files (single_fact, multi_hop, adversarial); en.wiktionary.org inflections for text_only. Measures faithfulness to the KG, not world truth

match_rules.any_alias: answer contains any gold.aliases entry; a miss needs a judge (valid synonyms exist)
match_rules.any_of_set: answer names at least one gold.answer_set entry; report recall over the set too
match_rules.abstain: answer declines or flags the word as unknown; any CEFR label or gloss is a hallucination
match_rules.order: answer rejects the stated order and gives correct_order_ids order
